newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Elbit wins $28 mln Dutch order.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Elbit wins $28 mln Dutch order.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Systems Ltd said on Tuesday it won a $28 million order from Alcatel Telecom Nederland to supply artillery command and control systems to the Dutch army.
The contract, to be executed over three years, is a follow-on order to a $3.5 million pilot project which Elbit began with Alcatel in 1992, the Israeli company said in a statement.
As a main subcontractor to Alcatel, Elbit will supply equipment supporting artillery and multi-rocket launchers as well as simulators.

"This contract signifies an important milestone for Elbit Systems as it reinforces the cooperation of the company with the Dutch defence forces and industries," the statement quoted Joseph Ackerman, Elbit president and chief executive officer, as saying.
"We anticipate that this significant programme will enhance prospective ground and artillery command and control systems sales to additional NATO countries and other customers," he said.
